profile.headline: Sr. Mobile Software Engineer
profile.summary: I’m a senior mobile software engineer with 10y+ experience delivering quality, scalable, end-to-end mobile solutions. I’m passionate about driving business forward through evangelizing new technology, leading mobile adoption and strategy, and building apps with an exceptional user experience.

positions.title: Mobile Software Engineer
positions.description:
Delivering quality, scalable, end-to-end native mobile app solutions:

•	Deep experience building complex iOS applications that include storyboarding, navigation patterns, touch and gestures, notifications, login, touch ID, core data and location, AppStore publishing

•	Expertise building Xamarin cross-platform mobile applications, utilizing C# and the underlying .NET framework, including async, generics, lambdas and other valuable syntactical sugar

•	Preparing project proposals, estimations, strategy and planning, prototyping

•	Designing and architecting RESTful APIs for mobile consumption

•	Implementing testing solutions, crash reporting, analytics, automated CI/CD pipelines

positions.title: Mobile Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Built full-stack iOS/Android applications, enabling employees to engage in more open and honest feedback to their employers, and for employers to effectively identify and implement employee engagement drivers

•	Rapidly delivered features utilizing React Native’s hybrid mobile framework and Redux architecture

•	Implemented Auth0 passwordless flows, secure API access, JWT token signing and management

•	Guided the mobile product vision, features roadmap, and standing up continuous delivery mechanisms

positions.title: iOS Developer, IT Architect
positions.description:
Developed features for the award winning customer iPhone travel app.
•	worked on an agile delivery team that defined scope of work, consulted on UI/UX requirements, developed new features to spec, employed TDD and CI, conducted code reviews, pair programming, product demos, and retrospectives
•	Objective-C and Swift programming
•	iOS7, iOS8, Notifications, Core Location
•	Cocoa Pods, Urban Airship

IT Architect helped to define application development best practices and technology roadmap.

Kickstarted enterprise mobile development initiatives serving as the iOS lead and mobile evangelist.
•	designed, developed (C# .NET), and launched beta employee travel app for iOS, Android and Windows platforms using Xamarin cross-platform mobile solution

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and built web applications to help clients expand their businesses

•	Defined project requirements and delivery timeline

•	Generated mock ups, web graphics, and logos

•	Developed websites, content management systems, database-driven web applications

positions.title: Transaction and Legal Manager
positions.description:
•	Improved commercial and contract processes to meet growing needs of the business

•	Key contributor on organization-wide implementation of order management process and Salesforce.com deployment

•	Oversaw negotiations and contract approvals for the entire business

•	Automated complex business workflows and implemented improved reporting and tracking
